items.t: 1 gram elemental calcium in divided doses (e.g. calcium carbonate, oral, 500 mg 12 hourly or 1 g in the morning). • For women at high risk of pre-eclampsia, e.g. pre-eclampsia in a previous pregnancy, chronic hypertension or
Calcium carbonate, oral, 1–4 tablets chewed 8 hourly with meals. · 1 tablet is equivalent to 0.168 g elemental calcium.
